author_context: Written without reading fresh_inventory/acquisition_v2/run/sealed or any fresh450 response, grade, latency, fee, token, or judge content. Only acquisition metadata (BLINDING.md, STATE.json blinded_acquisition/blinding_incident entries, confirmation_assembly checkpoints) was read.
purpose: One-shot confirmation, on the 450 reserved fresh tasks, of the information-value claims of the manuscript 'Quality, Queue, and Radio Information for Wireless Edge-Cloud LLM Routing'.

population.tasks: 450 reserved tasks: 150 native multi-turn IFBench, 150 XSum, 150 MBPP (train/validation), with 900 paired responses and 600 summary-judge captures as acquired.
population.caveat: Not an IID replication of the 225-task evaluation bank: IFBench is multi-turn and cohorts differ. Claims are stated for this population only.
population.unit_of_inference: Whole task (all turns, both routes, all attempts, all judges). Never split turns, routes, or judges into independent observations.

frozen_methods.controllers: qbr/information_value.py spec(): intrinsic, utility@b12, shortfall@b12, cq (kappa=0.5), fpi (Eq. 4), cq_release, mean_cq, mean_release, oracle_cq, always_edge, always_cloud. No coefficient, weight, or threshold may change.
frozen_methods.service_statistics: Calibration serving state data/serving_state.npz (sha256 0d261b9d84ecbbec30d15291cb0b7bc7dc4e53e299ec6101e0590426e85a058f) is reused unchanged for waits, residuals, fees, mean bits, and arrival normalisation. It is not refitted on fresh data.
frozen_methods.predictors: CARROT-KNN-SBERT and the quantile-forest Mean model exactly as trained on the 660 calibration tasks. Fresh-prompt inference code and trained-artifact hashes MUST be appended in executor_commitment before unsealing (see prerequisites).
frozen_methods.radio_and_traffic: data/config.json (sha256 6798cba770ab3c70a0b861c7c3b4e9f035e8c3ce5a6a75e659a6d630018029a0): 12 conditions, 20 seeds 23924000-23924019, beta=12, gamma=1000; load sweep rho {0.35,0.5,0.65,0.8,0.9}; payload scales {1,4,8,12}; one serial edge slot.
frozen_methods.achieved_cost: L + 12*max(q - realized quality, 0) + 1000*all charged fees, with the acquisition's quality scoring contracts; empty answers score zero.

confirmatory_hypotheses.claim: Queue state has value that grows with load.
confirmatory_hypotheses.test: Shortfall-Queue minus Intrinsic at rho=0.9 (primary radio, four edge slots) is negative, and its magnitude exceeds that at rho=0.35.
confirmatory_hypotheses.decision: Confirmed if the task-cluster bootstrap 95% interval of the rho=0.9 difference is below zero AND the interval of (rho=0.9 difference minus rho=0.35 difference) is below zero.

confirmatory_hypotheses.claim: Quality information has larger headroom than any rule refinement.
confirmatory_hypotheses.test: Oracle-Queue minus CARROT-Queue (12 conditions) is negative and larger in magnitude than |CARROT-Queue minus Utility-Queue|.
confirmatory_hypotheses.decision: Confirmed if the oracle interval is below zero and its upper bound is below minus the absolute point estimate of CARROT-Queue minus Utility-Queue.

confirmatory_hypotheses.claim: Radio value is governed by nominal airtime load.
confirmatory_hypotheses.test: Mean-Radio minus Mean-Queue at payload scale 12 (100 kHz) is negative; at payload scale 1 its absolute relative change is below 0.7%.
confirmatory_hypotheses.decision: Confirmed if the scale-12 interval is below zero and the scale-1 interval lies within +/-0.7% of Mean-Queue cost.

confirmatory_hypotheses.claim: Load-derived kappa (FPI) beats fixed kappa=0.5 with one serial edge slot (exploratory on the old bank).
confirmatory_hypotheses.test: FPI-Queue minus CARROT-Queue, one serial edge slot, 12 conditions.
confirmatory_hypotheses.decision: Confirmed if the interval is below zero. Not confirmed otherwise; reported either way.

descriptive_only: CARROT-Queue minus Utility-Queue at matched beta in {4,8,12,16,24,36}; expected sign changes are reported, not tested.
CARROT-Radio minus CARROT-Queue across payload scales and the paired radio decision diagnostic.
All Table I rows and serial-edge column.

inference.primary: Task-cluster bootstrap: 2000 resamples of whole tasks within service strata, each resample replayed on the 12 conditions (or stated sweep) with two fixed traffic seeds 23924000/1; percentile 95% intervals.
inference.secondary: Paired t intervals over 20 traffic seeds conditional on the task set, reported alongside.
inference.multiplicity: Four confirmatory hypotheses; each is judged at its own 95% interval and the family result is reported as the count confirmed out of four, without selective emphasis.

exposure_handling.primary_scope: All 450 tasks (no exposure-based exclusion; the full extent of the 2026-09-23 incident is unknown).
exposure_handling.sensitivity_scope: 447 tasks excluding the three known exposed IDs; reported next to the primary scope. Neither scope is described as pristine.
exposure_handling.rationale: The controllers, weights, and hypotheses above were fixed from the old 225-task bank and never tuned on fresh content; exposure could bias only through the analyst, whose choices are frozen here.

prerequisites_before_unsealing: P1 Grading executor completed and validated on authored fixtures only: IFBench multi-turn verifier, MBPP withheld-test sandbox (the code normalizer is recorded as blocked), and fixed summary-judge parsing. Hashes appended to executor_commitment.
P2 Transfer of raw acquisition records into replay profiles (chunks, bytes, service times, retries, fees) integrated and tested on synthetic fixtures; hashes appended.
P3 Fresh-prompt predictor inference (CARROT embeddings/KNN, forest features) and its timing measurement fixed and hashed, including the multi-turn prompt view.
P4 An append-only exposure receipt stating who opens the sealed store, when, and for which frozen executor hashes.
P5 An explicit unsealing decision by the researcher after reviewing P1-P4.
after_unsealing: Single execution of the frozen pipeline. Any bug fix after unsealing is a recorded deviation with before/after results both reported. No new controllers, weights, conditions, or hypotheses are added to the confirmatory set.
